related_questions.question: How much does a lumpectomy cost compared to a mastectomy?

text_blocks.snippet: The cost of lumpectomy and mastectomy can vary, but generally, lumpectomy, when combined with radiation, can be more expensive than mastectomy alone, especially in the short term. However, over a longer period, lumpectomy with radiation can be more cost-effective.
snippet_highlighted_words: lumpectomy, when combined with radiation, can be more expensive than mastectomy alone, especially in the short term

list.title: Shorter hospital stays:
list.snippet: Lumpectomies generally involve shorter hospital stays compared to mastectomies, potentially lowering immediate costs.

list.title: Radiation therapy:
list.snippet: Lumpectomy is often followed by radiation therapy, which adds to the overall cost. Radiation therapy can range from $7,000 to $15,000 or more, depending on the type and intensity.

list.title: Physician fees:
list.snippet: While hospital inpatient fees may be lower for lumpectomy, total physician fees, including those for radiation oncologists, can be higher, according to a JAMA study.

list.title: Higher initial costs:
list.snippet: Mastectomies can have higher initial costs, especially if breast reconstruction is involved.

list.title: Lower long-term costs:
list.snippet: In some cases, mastectomy without reconstruction may have lower long-term costs compared to lumpectomy with radiation, according to a study published in the Journal of the National Cancer Institute.

list.title: Reconstruction costs:
list.snippet: Breast reconstruction adds significantly to the cost of mastectomy. Reconstruction can range from $5,000 to $15,000 per breast, according to Bankrate.

list.title: Insurance coverage:
list.snippet: Insurance coverage plays a significant role in the final out-of-pocket costs for both procedures. Copays, deductibles, and coinsurance can vary widely.

list.title: Type of surgery:
list.snippet: The specific type of mastectomy (e.g., simple, modified radical, or skin-sparing) and the extent of reconstruction can affect the cost.

list.title: Location of care:
list.snippet: Costs can vary based on the hospital or surgery center and geographic location.

list.title: Complications:
list.snippet: Any complications arising from either surgery can lead to increased costs.

list.title: Age:
list.snippet: Older women on Medicare may experience lower treatment costs for both mastectomy and lumpectomy, says a report from OncLive.

text_blocks.snippet: Overall, it's important to discuss the specific costs associated with each procedure with your healthcare provider and insurance company to get a personalized estimate.
